summary: A small local Idea Analyser app for Gen-Z employees, with a static web UI and a Node.js/Express API. It sends submitted ideas to Gemini and also provides one random funny/corny Gen-Z business idea preset.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace is empty and contains no existing project files to augment.

questions.question: Which programming language for Idea Analyser API?
questions.rationale: TypeScript runs on Node.js and fits the required backend language choices; the user explicitly requested Node.js + Express.

questions.question: Which framework for Idea Analyser API?

options.label: Express
options.description: Minimal Node.js web framework for the requested API and static UI

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Idea Analyser API.
questions.answer: Serve the static web UI; POST /post forwards the submitted idea to Gemini using only process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY. Keep the Gemini feedback prompt at 200 words or fewer; return feasibility/interest feedback in a Gen-Z voice, with no abuse or profanity, under 100 words. GET /get returns one randomly selected item from about four funny/corny Gen-Z business idea presets.
questions.rationale: Distilled directly from the user's request.
questions.recommendedChoice: Serve the static web UI; POST /post forwards the submitted idea to Gemini using only process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY. Keep the Gemini feedback prompt at 200 words or fewer; return feasibility/interest feedback in a Gen-Z voice, with no abuse or profanity, under 100 words. GET /get returns one randomly selected item from about four funny/corny Gen-Z business idea presets.
